name: bingo mad angles very peri peri
ingredients_raw: CEREALS AND PULSES MIX {RICE GRLS, DEGERMED CORN GRITS, BENGAL GRAM GRITS AND PEA GRITS}, *EDIBLE VEGETABLE OIL, *SPICES AND CONDIMENTS, IODIZED SALT, GARLIC POWDER, SUGAR, TAMARIND POWDER, NATURE IDENTICAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES, MILK SOLIDS, MALTODEXTRIN, FLAVOUR ENHANCERS (508, 635), ONION POWDER, NATURAL FLAVOURS AND NATURAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES, ACIDITY REGULATOR (CITRIC ACID) AND YEAST EXTRACT. *TO KNOW THE SPECIFIC TYPE OF OIL USED, MATCH THE SYMBOL (A OR AA) WITH THE LAST CHARACTER OF BATCH NUMBER WHEREIN A DENOTES REFINED PALMOLEIN AND AA DENOTES REFINED RICE BRAN OIL. "USED AS FLAVOURING AGENTS. CONTAINS SOY, MILK. MAY CONTAIN WHEAT, BARLEY.
